spans.s:
तृतीय तृतीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. त्रि), the third;
forming or constituting the third part; (अस्), m.,
scil. वर्ण, the third consonant of a Varga (i. e.
ग्, ज्, ड्, द्, ब्); (आ), f., scil. तिथि, the third day in
a half month; scil. विभक्ति, the terminations of
the third case, the third case, the instrumental;
(अम्), n. a third part; (अम् or एन), ind. at or
for the third time, thirdly; [cf. Zend thri-tya;
Lith. tré-cia-s of trétias; Lat. ter-tius; Gr. τρίτος;
Goth. thri-dya; Slav. tre-tiĭ; Scot. tri-teamh;
Hib. triugha.]
—तृतीय-ता, f. ‘thirdness,’ the con-
dition of the third consonant of a Varga.
—तृतीय-
प्रकृति, इस्, f. (‘the third nature’), a eunuch; the
neuter gender.
—तृतीय-सवन, अम्, n., Ved. the
third Soma offering (in the evening).
—तृतीय-
सवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the third Soma
offering.
—तृतीय-स्वर, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
—तृतीयांश (˚य-अं˚), अस्, m. a third part; (अस्,
आ, अम्), receiving a third as one's share.
—तृतीया-
प्रकृति, इस्, f. a eunuch; a hermaphrodite; the
neuter gender, = तृतीय-प्रकृति.
—तृतीया-स-
मास, अस्, m. a compound word (Tat-puruṣa), the
former member of which would stand in the instru-
mental case, if separated from the latter.

तृतीयक, अस्, इका, अम्, recurring every third day,
tertian (as fever &c.); occurring for the third time;
the third; (इका), f. = तृतीया, the third day in a half
month.
—तृतीयक-ज्वर, अस्, m. tertian ague.

तृतीया-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to plough for the third time.
—तृतीया-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, thrice ploughed (as a field).

तृतीयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, holding the third place or
rank; having or receiving a third as one's share.

तृत्सु तृत्सु, उस्, m., अवस्, m. pl., Ved., N. of
a Vedic race or family; (Sāy.) injurious, an enemy.
